title: qa-run-chatbot chatbot-run.json — conversational case-set run receipt
description: Output of the qa-run-chatbot skill, written to <evid_root>/<key>/chatbot-run.json. The control plane branches on `status` only, maps `cases` to per-case rows, and PROPOSES verdicts a human disposes. Vocabulary mirrors qa-run-case.json where the shapes coincide (media kinds, PASS|FAIL|PARTIAL|BLOCKED — no MANUAL: a chat case a machine can't grade is BLOCKED with the reason). A tooling failure that prevents any grading writes NO artifact (the runner's missing-artifact ok:false path).

status.description: Run grade — worst-of the cases. PASS = every case passed. FAIL = at least one case FAIL. PARTIAL = no FAIL, at least one PARTIAL. BLOCKED = a run-level blocker (env down, auth gate, tenant mismatch, driver dead) prevented or truncated the run — exact reason in `summary`.

summary.description: One honest line: '<x>/<n> pass' plus the lead finding. For FAIL quote the strongest failing evidence verbatim; for BLOCKED state the exact blocking reason.

cases.description: One row per case in set order, including cases never attempted (those are BLOCKED with class `tooling` or `env`).

id.description: Case id from the set (T1, T2, …).

status.description: PASS = pass criteria met AND persistence confirmed where applicable. FAIL = fail phrase hit, or claimed success contradicted by the independent read. PARTIAL = landed with a mismatch (described verbatim in evidence). BLOCKED = could not attempt/complete (class says why).

failure_class.description: Required in spirit whenever status != PASS — the classify-before-adapt key the recipe routes on.

evidence.description: Verbatim quotes grounding the grade — the assistant's exact phrase and/or what the independent UI read showed. Never a paraphrase.

ui_verified.description: OPTIONAL. True when the grade includes an independent UI/API persistence read (not just chat text).

transcript.description: OPTIONAL. Relative path (under the artifact dir) to the full verbatim transcript for this case.

failure_modes.description: OPTIONAL (TICKETS mode). The regression table: every failure mode mined from the ticket(s) × whether it reproduced in this run.

mode.description: The documented failure mode, verbatim where it was a phrase.

new_observations.description: OPTIONAL. Behaviors surfaced that no ticket mentioned — findings a human may want to ticket (this skill never files one).

media.description: OPTIONAL, best-effort — same shape and semantics as qa-run-case.json media[].

url.description: The evidence URL as the evidence_store adapter returned it.

notes.description: OPTIONAL. Flakes observed, brain writes made ('nothing new this run' is valid), early-stop reasons with class.
